about.adults.body: BetaSuite is made for adults working with explicit material. Do not use it if you are under 18, or under the age of majority where you live.
about.adults.title: For adults only
about.imperfect.body: BetaSuite finds most of what you choose to hide, but not all of it. Fast motion, poor light, unusual angles, small areas and partly covered bodies make misses more likely. Check a result before you rely on it or share it.
about.imperfect.title: Detection misses things
